_doc: Which optional facts a goal turns on: a fact is added to the state/options when the goal text contains one of its words. 'lines' = line/turn/extend phrases and the 'Lines of buildings so far' state line; 'band' = 'joins touching buildings that then line … sides' and the 'Touching buildings along the civic centre' state line (both only with the gate_lines flag). Generic for every civ; edit here, not in code. 'cc_gap' = the house's distance to the civic centre in each option (only with the gate_cc flag).
